title: Why Broadridge Financial Solutions Stock Is Soaring Today
author: Josh Kohn-Lindquist
description: Broadridge Financial Solutions stock surged 7% after reporting Q4 earnings that exceeded Wall Street expectations, with full-year revenue and adjusted EPS growing 8% and 12% respectively. The company announced a 12% dividend increase (20th consecutive year) and guided for 2027 sales growth of 6-8% and adjusted EPS growth of 8-12%. Despite a 32% decline over the past year due to disruption concerns from tokenization and digitization, the analyst views the stock as an attractive buy-the-dip opportunity trading at 16x free cash flow with a 2.5% dividend yield.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q4 earnings beat with 8% revenue growth and 12% adjusted EPS growth. Management provided solid 2027 guidance (6-8% sales growth, 8-12% EPS growth), announced 20th consecutive dividend increase, and stock is trading at attractive valuation (16x FCF). Despite past year decline, company demonstrates resilience and is well-positioned for digital transformation with agentic AI integration.
